concerns.text: Edge case 'simulate on the largest connected component only and record the size of the discarded components' has no backing FR. FR-001/FR-002 cover loading and transmission only. Add an FR (e.g., FR-008) anchored to US-1 covering largest-connected-component extraction and logging of discarded component sizes.

Edge case 'report the threshold as "undefined" or "> max tested beta" rather than returning null' has no FR. Add an FR anchored to US-2 specifying the sentinel reporting behavior for unreached epidemic thresholds so the statistical analysis (FR-005) has a defined input.

US-2 scenario 3 requires the system to explicitly flag findings as 'not statistically significant' when p > 0.05, but no FR covers this reporting behavior — FR-005 only covers performing the t-test and computing Cohen's d. Extend FR-005 or add an FR to anchor this outcome.
